entities.span: **Data model sketch**: none new. This feature reads feature 15's already committed `ARCHETYPES` and `PAIRS` (`src/features/scoring/eval/`) and writes only to a gitignored local file; no table, no migration.

**State transitions**: none, a script run start to finish. Per pair verdict states: `pass` · `fail` · `inconclusive` (sub reasons `insufficient-successes`, `no-majority`). Run level states: `completed` · `aborted` (carrying a `UsageGateReason`).
**API surface**: not a request surface. The one "endpoint" is the command line:
A pair's five reruns are never fired concurrently with each other; only different pairs' test bodies may overlap (AC-2), bounded by `maxConcurrency` (Build plan, step 1).
A verdict is never printed or reported without its denominator alongside it (AC-6).
`pnpm eval` is never reachable from `pnpm test` or `pnpm test:integration`: it is its own Vitest project, selected only by explicit `--project eval` (which the `pnpm eval` script wraps)
rejected_spans: , so no existing command starts spending real vendor calls by accident

entities.span: Nothing under `test/eval/` or `test/helpers/eval-verdict.ts` names a vendor package or a model id; every real call goes through `scoreListing()`, and the reported model id goes through the shared `resolvedModel()` guard (AC-11).
The `BAND_ANCHORS` drift assertions (AC-10) live in the ordinary unit suite (`pnpm test`), never behind a vendor call
rejected_spans: , so a rubric edit is caught on every push, not only when someone happens to run the harness

entities.span: The minted fixture user is deleted (`deleteFixtureUser`) after the report is written, in an `afterAll`. Cleanup runs after the report write, in that order
rejected_spans: matching `test/helpers/fixture-user.ts`'s own reason for existing: an undeleted fixture user otherwise accumulates in the local database on every run, the same way `fit-scoring-live.test.ts` already avoids it
so a cleanup failure can never destroy the run's own output

entities.span: One session is expected to outlive the whole run (sixteen pairs, bounded concurrency, five sequential calls each): this is assumed to comfortably fit inside Supabase's session lifetime today, and is not re verified per call.
If feature 15's set grows large enough, or `ai_scoring` itself grows slower, to approach that lifetime, this assumption needs revisiting (Follow up).
**Security model**: No user facing surface and no user data.

The fixture session this feature mints is the same development only, `DEV_SESSION_ENABLED` gated path `test/helpers/session.ts` and `test/helpers/fixture-user.ts` already use for `fit-scoring-live.test.ts`; nothing new is added to that gate.
The one real exposure is that every archetype's `summary`, `skills`, and `experience` text reaches OpenAI on every run of this command
rejected_spans: , which is exactly spec 0016's own AC-1 (no real person, no real employer) doing its job here too

entities.span: **Configuration required**: none new. Reuses `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, and `DEV_SESSION_ENABLED`, already validated by `src/env.ts` and already required for the local Supabase stack this command needs running.

Happy path: `pnpm eval -t control-direct-match` scores that one pair for real, five sequential reruns under the one minted session, and prints a passing verdict with its denominator (e.g. "strong_match, 5 of 5 succeeded"), verifies **AC-1**, **AC-2**, **AC-6**, **AC-9**.
entities.label: Happy path

entities.span: Failure case: a pair whose five reruns come back as 2 scored and 3 vendor failures is reported `inconclusive` (`insufficient-successes`) rather than a false pass or fail, the run's own exit code is non zero, and the other pairs in the same run still complete, verifies **AC-3**, **AC-7**.
entities.label: Failure case

entities.span: Abort case: constructed against `test/helpers/eval-verdict.test.ts`'s own fixtures, the first rerun outcome carrying `allowed: false` (any `UsageGateReason`) stops the run from counting it toward any denominator and marks the run `aborted`, verifies **AC-3**.
entities.label: Abort case

entities.span: Data quality gate: `validateGroundTruth()` returning even one issue against a deliberately broken fixture set stops the command before any vendor call is made, verifies **AC-1**.
entities.label: Data quality gate

entities.span: Cross pair check: constructed verdicts where `preference-match` lands on `strong_match` but `preference-violation` lands on `good_match` (with `preference-title-conflict` unchanged) trip `preference-leak-suspected`, while all three landing together on `good_match` instead trips `baseline-drift`, verified against `test/helpers/eval-verdict.test.ts`'s own fixtures rather than a real run, verifies **AC-5**.
entities.label: Cross pair check

entities.span: Drift guard: editing `BAND_ANCHORS`'s text fails the AC-10 test by name, under the ordinary free `pnpm test`, verifies **AC-10**.
entities.label: Drift guard
